_comment: Grandfathered files for scripts/ci/check-hot-table-ddl-lock-timeout.ts.
Every file listed here contains at least one barrier-forming DDL statement
on a hot table (organizations / anchors / profiles) with no bounded
lock_timeout preceding it. They are already merged and already applied, so
flagging them would only block unrelated PRs. New violations in any file NOT
listed here fail CI.
Why per-file grandfathering is safe: merged migrations are immutable
(supabase/migrations/agents.md hard rule, hook-enforced), so a new violation
cannot be smuggled into an already-listed file. A NEW migration file must be
clean, which is the whole point of the ratchet.
Do NOT add entries to shrink a red build. Add the one-line guard instead:
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
Created 2026-08-11 after the P0 in HANDOFF.md: an unguarded ALTER TABLE on
public.organizations queued behind two ~50-minute readers, and because
Postgres lock queues are FIFO it became a barrier in front of PostgREST's
schema-cache introspection. /api/v1/verify served service_unavailable for
11m39s. Baseline at creation: 151 violations across 16 files (117 of them in
the pg_dump-shaped baseline migration, which is not hand-written SQL).
2026-08-11 addendum — 0407 added. NOT to shrink a red build for its own PR:
0407 merged (a3e3d6e26) in the same window this guard shipped (352e74967) and
raced the baseline snapshot, so it was never eligible to be caught pre-merge.
It is merged AND applied to prod (ledger version 0407, verified via MCP), which
makes it immutable under CLAUDE.md 1.2 and the migration-edit hook — the
one-line guard CANNOT be added to it. Left unlisted it failed this gate on
EVERY open PR including ones touching no SQL at all (e.g. #2171, auth.ts only).
That is precisely the 'would only block unrelated PRs' case this list exists for.
The ratchet is unchanged for new files.
